item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description: What's new in 1.2.0 • New details page with Resume, Start Over and More Like This • Recommendations that learn what you like • Live TV: one click for full screen, new TV Guide with show progress • Enhanced TV Guide with real programme names • Player: screen lock, clearer loading, proper audio and subtitle names • Resume continues where you left off • My Stats with live charts and insights • Many fixes and speed improvements
